disposition: Not cleared. These commits expand production replay and captured-output correction paths. This is a source audit, not a visual or functional acceptance run.

findings.issue: Scenario-selected captured run identity. LaunchRunning and LaunchFailure overwrite trace_label with run-202609030914-b5df. LaunchRun now has a second identity string whose documentation explicitly says it retains the captured ID.
findings.reference: Frozen and design cockpit.rs:82-95 derive the displayed run ID from the injected world clock and generated instance suffix; cockpit.rs:969 uses the same run.run_id.
findings.replacement_owner: The Jackin domain owns one real run identity derived from its clock and instance identity. Determinism belongs in injected clock/data, not a scenario-specific captured string. The UI consumes that identity.

findings.issue: Private trace correction painter uses literal link RGB, manual coordinates and character counts. Its NO_COLOR branch repaints the brand only at exactly 120 by 40. It runs after the historical launch frame at lines 9545-9549. This is an exact-size production alternate implementation and an application correction painter.
findings.reference: Frozen and design cockpit.rs:969-979 use terminal-cell width, semantic link styling and contrast, plus a real CHIP_RUN clickable region. Frozen app_tests_colour.rs:169 tests the debug run chip as a link at 140 by 40.
findings.replacement_owner: Use a real shared link/action or toolbar content component with live run label, semantic style and stable ID. Shared layout owns placement and terminal-cell width; the same resolved region owns pointer/focus/cursor behavior. Retain the domain action and click semantics.

findings.issue: The pre-existing historical launch selector remains tied to exact 120 by 40, LaunchRunning, paused motion and frame 40. The new changes extend its fixed 4800-cell production replay to ANSI256/16 and Mono. The production presentation crate supplies fixed RUNS, not live component output.
findings.reference: crates/jackin-preview-presentation/src/launch_running.rs:1623-1636 writes fixed positions, text and RGB runs; its module comment identifies the paused frame-40 120 by 40 reference screen.
findings.replacement_owner: Replace this complete replay path with live shared blocks/widgets supplied by launch view data. Keep captured frames and RUNS only in test artifacts. Remove the selector and replay dependency in the same verified migration increment.

findings.issue: Generic raw-color conversion now gains more exact RGB exceptions, and public LegacyMono/legacy_mono translates captured color pairs into link underline and top-menu reverse via a menu_row flag. Color pairs cannot identify semantic component roles. This moves reference-frame correction into Termrock rather than replacing it with reusable behavior.
findings.reference: Frozen theme.rs:3002-3073 converts arbitrary RGB through general algorithms. Frozen theme.rs:920 onward and 1053-1112 independently author semantic palette roles by profile. Semantic accent index 78 and Mono link/brand styling must remain semantic decisions.
findings.replacement_owner: Theme owns authored semantic palettes and component recipes, with provenance preserved through generic custom-color conversion. Shared link and brand components own underline/reverse state. Replace raw captured-pair exceptions with role-based input; retain arbitrary custom RGB behavior and neighboring-color coverage.

findings.issue: The new public downgrade_pair unconditionally replaces ANSI16 White on DarkGray with Black, including explicitly named colors. A contrast repair can be legitimate, but this exact-pair rule is not a general contrast policy and is justified only as baseline matching in its comment.
findings.reference: Frozen theme.rs:1624-1655 has a general legible() contract: contrast threshold, semantic strong colors, text ladder and best contrasting text ink.
findings.replacement_owner: Reuse or expose the existing semantic contrast policy at component resolution, or document an explicit general opt-in pair policy with custom-color tests. Do not infer a reference component from one painted pair.

findings.issue: Adding public trace_label introduces a required field for external LaunchRun struct literals and a second mutable source for run identity. No consumer compatibility proof was supplied.
findings.replacement_owner: Prefer an accessor or a constructor-owned single domain identity, with external consumer compilation if a public shape change is retained.

important_qualification: Do not claim raw #48e054 must map to index 77 under the frozen algorithm. Frozen nearest_256 uses coarse channel quantization and produces 78 for that RGB. The objection is the captured-value exception mechanism and mixed semantic/custom-color ownership, not a blanket rejection of index 78. The pre-existing frozen_ansi256 table is an older unresolved concern; these commits expand it.
useful_changes_to_retain: The intent to remove the old historical_cockpit_debug file is valid, but its captured label and repaint mechanism have been recreated elsewhere and are not a completed removal.
Live run identity and a capability-aware debug link are valid product requirements. Implement them through domain data and shared semantic components.
Explicit semantic palette values such as ANSI256 accent 78 and Mono text/link roles can legitimately differ from raw RGB approximation. Preserve reviewed palette provenance and custom overrides.
next_bounded_increments: First repair theme ownership: remove newly introduced captured RGB/pair attribute inference while keeping semantic palette projection. Add arbitrary and neighboring RGB tests, explicit named-color tests, and all-four-profile semantic component tests. Review any general raw-conversion algorithm change against both the frozen implementation and current public custom-color contracts.

Then replace the Jackin debug trace correction with a shared live link/action component and one real domain run ID. Test displayed identity against copy/log domain results, pointer activation, focus, hover, Unicode cell width, all color profiles, NO_COLOR, and adjacent dimensions 119/120/121 by 39/40/41.

Finally migrate the paused launch cockpit from fixed RUNS to live shared composition. Verify changed launch stages/data and controlled times, frame 39/40/41, normal and failure flows, then remove production replay and the exact selector. Compare pinned real CLI reference/candidate checkpoints without updating expected output from the candidate.
verification: Read-only git object inspection and exact commit diff. No source edits, no helper agents, no screenshot or native-test pass claimed. Existing tests mirroring LegacyMono captured mappings do not establish acceptance.

quantizer_followup.source: Frozen and design src/theme.rs:3017-3034 have byte-identical nearest_256 bodies.
quantizer_followup.recommendation: Remove captured exceptions by restoring a documented general source-backed raw RGB quantizer, with arbitrary neighboring-color tests. If choosing a different generic approximation for API reasons, record an explicit reference/API decision and its parity limits. Do not combine Euclidean approximation with a special accent exception or silently retain a captured gray238 expectation. Keep authored semantic palette values independent.
